text_plain: LSU had Tennessee tied at thirteen... Then a freshman quarterback took over with his legs. LSU jumped out six to nothing, and the Tigers tied it again late in the third. But in the fourth, Faizon Brandon exploded for an eighteen-yard touchdown run to take the lead! Then he broke loose for a fifty-five-yard dagger! Two touchdown runs... in just over four minutes. Tennessee won twenty-seven to thirteen, and Google Trends showed more than two hundred thousand U.S. searches for the matchup.
